final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- bias: IREF (assumed 10uA) into NMOS diode ----
MB1 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
MB2 pb    ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=1
MP0 pb    pb    vdd vdd pfet W=2 L=1
* ---- gain stage: NMOS common source + PMOS current-source load (~25uA) ----
MP1 x     pb    vdd vdd pfet W=2 L=1 m=10
M1  x     iin   vss vss nfet W=20 L=0.5
* ---- source follower output buffer (~7.5uA) ----
M2  vdd   x     vout vss nfet W=8 L=0.5
MB3 vout  ibias vss vss nfet W=3 L=1
* ---- shunt feedback network ----
Rf  vout  iin   150k
Cf  vout  iin   20f
.ends
